messages:
alex_reinhart: Hey team — need a short profiling window for a regression check on rw-v2-3b-quant. Planning an nsys + torch.profiler capture with KV warmup included. Should be ~10–15m, low traffic.
maria_ops: @alex_reinhart what's your preferred node (A100/RTX)? any scheduling constraints?
alex_reinhart: A100-80G preferred (batching path). Flexible today after 14:00 PST. Will run with sequence length 1024 and a few scripted prompts to hit cold & warm KV.
jordyn_perf: Please include a small flamegraph export and the raw nsys report. Also: redact pii before upload. Example capture commands helped me last time:
```
# NSYS
nsys profile --trace=cuda,osrt --output=/tmp/prof.$USER --sample=cpu --duration=900 \
  --force-overwrite --follow-through

# Torch profiler (snippet inside test harness)
with torch.profiler.profile(
    schedule=torch.profiler.schedule(wait=1, warmup=1, active=3),
    activities=[torch.profiler.ProfilerActivity.CPU, torch.profiler.ProfilerActivity.CUDA],
    record_shapes=True,
    with_stack=True,
) as prof:
    run_inference()
    prof.export_chrome_trace('/tmp/torch_trace.json')
```
sam_runtime: I can book a profiling slot. Which cluster pool? 'perf-a100-1' or 'perf-a100-2'?
alex_reinhart: perf-a100-1 please. I'll push a small harness to the test namespace and ping when ready.
maria_ops: FYI include the exact prompt list so we can replay. Also add a short preface in the artifact metadata: model, commit sha, config (batch, seq_len), and expected SLO we're testing vs.
alex_reinhart: will do. Prompts: ["Hello world", long_prompt_512, few_shot_prompt]. Commit: 8f9b2c1. Batch=1, seq=1024. Target p95 < 200ms token.
sam_runtime: reserving slot now.
deploy-bot: Slot reserved: perf-a100-1 / node-07 / window 2026-04-02T21:30:00Z - 2026-04-02T21:50:00Z (reservation id: res-2812345678). @alex_reinhart react with :thumbsup: to confirm.
alex_reinhart: :thumbsup: confirmed. I'll run an initial smoke to validate env then full capture.
jordyn_perf: Quick checklist before capture: 1) enable kernel symbols (devkit build), 2) set TORCH_CPP_LOG_LEVEL=info only if needed, 3) record raw nvtx ranges for decode/encode.
alex_reinhart: noted. I'll attach nvtx ranges and upload to s3: s3://redwood-profiling/2812345678/raw/
maria_ops: After upload, tag with `redact:pending` and we'll scrub logs before wider sharing. If anything sensitive is in traces, please mark for eng-sre review.
alex_reinhart: understood. I'll post back here with the final s3 path + small summary (size, time, notes) once complete. thanks everyone! :pray:
